lines.beaver: 마이클 씨, 김 교수님께 서류 냈어요?
lines.beaver_en: Michael, did you turn in the papers to Professor Kim?
lines.beaver_roman: Maikeul ssi, gim gyosunimkke seoryu naesseoyo?
lines.en: Not yet. What papers do I give the professor?

lines.beaver: 출석 확인서하고 유학 서류를 내야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: You need to submit an attendance form and study-abroad papers.
lines.beaver_roman: Chulseok hwaginseohago yuhak seoryureul naeya haeyo.
lines.en: Do international students really need the attendance form?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, of course. Attendance is very important.
lines.learner: 저는 지난주에 두 번 출석 못 했어요.
lines.en: I missed class twice last week.
lines.roman: Jeoneun jinanjue du beon chulseok motaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then write a short email to the professor.
lines.en: Okay, I'll send the professor an email today.

lines.beaver_en: What about the study-abroad papers? Are they all ready?
lines.learner: 네, 유학 서류는 노트 사이에 넣어 놨어요.
lines.en: Yes, I put them inside my notebook.
lines.roman: Ne, yuhak seoryuneun noteu saie neoeo nwasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Michael, you have a younger sibling, right? Middle schooler?
lines.en: No, my sibling is in elementary school.

lines.beaver_en: Really? How's school life for your sibling?
lines.learner: 잘 지내요. 학교에서 그림 상을 받았어요.
lines.en: They're doing well. They won a drawing prize at school.
lines.roman: Jal jinaeyo. Hakgyoeseo geurim sangeul badasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 대단하네요! 동생한테 축하한다고 전해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, amazing! Tell your sibling congratulations.
lines.beaver_roman: Wa, daedanhaneyo! Dongsaenghante chukahandago jeonhae juseyo.
lines.en: Sure, I'll call my sibling tonight.

lines.beaver: 서류는 내일 오전까지 교수님 방에 내면 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: Just hand the papers in at the professor's office by tomorrow morning.
lines.beaver_roman: Seoryuneun naeil ojeonkkaji gyosunim bange naemyeon dwaeyo.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll give the papers to the professor in person.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Ask me anytime if you're unsure.
lines.en: Okay, thank you so much. See you tomorrow!
